KeyPassages: Genesis 38:18; Exodus 28:11; 1 Kings 21:8; Song of Solomon 8:6
BiblicalUsage: A signet ring is a person's name in wax and stone, and Judah leaves his with Tamar as a pledge. The high priest's stones are engraved like a signet, and Jezebel seals letters with Ahab's ring to have Naboth killed. The Song turns the same image into a prayer: set me as a seal upon your heart.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a seal says two things at once: this belongs to someone, and this person stands behind it. Judah's seal convicts him, Jezebel's seal kills an innocent man, and the Song's seal asks for love that will not let go. My position is that God has sealed His own people the same way — marked as His, and held by Him.
